facts.text: Alex's vision in the departure lounge.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Alex boarding the plane and having the premonition before take-off. He is on the plane, not in the departure lounge.

vibe.verdict: The boarding pass and in-flight tray suit the film, and Rocky Mountain High is a good nod, but the deaths are barely on the menu.
missing: Tod's bathtub and the clothesline (the first death)
Ms Lewton's kitchen chain reaction (the Rube Goldberg death)
Alex changing seats with two classmates (before take-off)
Bludworth's mouse and cat speech (the funeral home)
Carter's car at the train crossing
The falling neon sign in Paris
ideas: Swap the note on 'Bludworth's funeral parlour madeleines' for 'We are all a mouse the cat has by the tail.'
Swap the note on 'Window seat French onion dip' for 'Alex swapped seats with two classmates before take-off.'
Swap the note on 'Premonition French 75' for 'Tod's memorial speech about the hour of death. Nobody drinks to that.'
